0022600170.text: The Suns (1-3, on a two-game losing streak) are 0-2 on the road and sit 11th in the West, 2 games back in the Pacific, as they make the fifth game of their 2026-27 season. The Golden State Warriors (3-3) are on a three-game winning streak, sit 10th in the West, and are second in the Pacific, a game back. The Suns lead the 2026-27 season series 1-0 after a 131-122 win in Phoenix on October 24, though they lost the 2025-26 series 1-3. Mark Williams is out for the Suns with a shoulder injury (surgery), while the Warriors are missing Jimmy Butler III (out, knee surgery), Kristaps Porzingis (out, illness), and Moses Moody (out, knee surgery).
